((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events e
  WHERE ((e.id = event_access_grants.event_id) AND (e.organizer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events
  WHERE ((events.id = event_images.event_id) AND (events.organizer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_participations p
  WHERE ((p.id = event_rejoin_requests.participation_id) AND (p.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

((uploaded_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_images
  WHERE (event_images.file_id = files.id))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversations c
  WHERE (c.id = messages.conversation_id)))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_participations p
  WHERE (p.id = participation_history.participation_id)))
((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = follower_id) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = followed_id))

((bucket_id = 'event_media'::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 2) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events
  WHERE (((events.id)::text = split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 2)) AND (events.organizer_id <> ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))))

policies.qual:
((bucket_id = 'event_media'::text) AND ((split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
